$comment: Shape of brand/tokens.json (written by the brand phase). Apply it with: npm run brand:apply -- ../brand/tokens.json. All 11 colour keys are required in both palettes, as hex (#rgb or #rrggbb). Text/background pairs should reach WCAG AA (4.5:1); the script warns, or fails with --strict. 'font' values are CSS font stacks (system stack by default; see README to switch to next/font). 'radius' is the base corner radius.

font.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
font.display: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
